comparison.objective: Push snug foam protectors onto bare picture-frame corners; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-edge push-fit alignment while bracing a loose frame differs from threaded setting, jam-nut countertorque, and tool regrasping.
comparison.success_condition: Protectors fully seated without disturbing frame or existing protectors versus locked angular setting retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: All twelve indexed spec versions remain push-fit protection tasks and do not test adjustment preservation.
